summary: VMS Work Request Workflow Testing Complete - All new workflow features verified: Create Work Request (no vendor), Add Proposals with vendor, Select proposal, Submit for Approval, Convert to Work Order
critical_code_review_comments: Workflow banner shows clear 4-step process: Create Request → Add Proposals → Select & Approve → Convert to Order
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing
Convert to Work Order endpoint properly validates: requires approval status and vendor selection
Proposal comparison view shows lowest/highest bid summary
seed_data_creation: Created test work requests via backend tests with TEST_ prefix for identification
context_for_next_testing_agent: VMS Work Request Workflow fully tested. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_vms_work_request_workflow.py cover: create request without vendor, add proposal with vendor, select proposal (sets vendor), submit for approval, approval workflow, convert to order, validation rules. Frontend verified: workflow banner, new request dialog, proposals tab with comparison view, approval tab with submit button, convert to order button.

Backend: POST /api/vendors/requirements.details: Creates work request without vendor - status 'draft', no selected_vendor_id

Backend: POST /api/vendors/requirements/.details: Adds proposal with vendor_id, amount, currency, delivery_days - status 'submitted'

Backend: GET /api/vendors/requirements/{.details: Returns proposals with comparison data (lowest_amount, highest_amount, proposal_count)

Backend: POST /api/vendors/requirements/.details: Selects proposal and sets vendor on request - status changes to 'vendor_selected'
Creates approval record with 3 levels (team_lead, manager, finance)

Backend: POST /api/vendors/approvals/{id.details: Processes approval at each level, updates approval_status when all levels approved

Backend: POST /api/vendors/requirements/.details: Creates work order from approved request, copies vendor, amount, description

Frontend: Work Requests page loads.details: Page shows workflow banner, filter buttons, request cards

Frontend: Workflow overview banner.details: Shows 4 steps: Create Request → Add Proposals → Select & Approve → Convert to Order

Frontend: New Request dialog.details: Form with Title, Department, Expected Completion Date, Description fields

Frontend: Proposals tab.details: Shows comparison summary (Total Proposals, Lowest Bid, Highest Bid), proposal cards with Select button

Frontend: Approval tab - Submit button.details: Shows 'Ready for Approval' message and 'Submit for Approval' button when vendor selected

Frontend: Convert to Work Order button.details: Button appears on approval tab when request is approved and not yet converted
